items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: I was playing at Billy Phillips the other night that played for Billy Phillips.

ctx.x: Yeah, I never heard talk of Buddy Ford though. I don't know who that is.

Frank Early was a nightclub owner too. And he lived. It was during the time that his short life of Gypsy Blood killed Billy Phillips. I was playing at Billy Phillips. I was playing at Billy Phillips the other night that played for Billy Phillips. The other night Gypsy Blood killed Billy Phillips. I just got paid. The 20 minutes after, that was Easter Monday. I got paid the 20 minutes after Billy Phillips was killed. He was killed at, let's see, at 4 o'clock. And we got paid 20 minutes after 4. If we hadn't got…
